summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to allow Medicare to cover additional lung cancer screening tests that are approved by the Food and Drug Administration, beyond those currently covered, as preventive services.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands Medicare coverage for lung cancer screening tests, which directly relates to public healthcare provision and access. The expansion of covered services under Medicare leans towards more public healthcare.

The bill expands Medicare coverage for additional lung cancer screening tests, which would increase federal spending on Part B preventive services and thus tend to enlarge the deficit. However, the legislation is narrowly focused on coverage authority rather than fiscal policy, making the deficit impact tangential at best.

The core purpose of the bill is to authorize the Secretary to cover additional FDA-cleared lung cancer screening tests under Medicare as preventive services, directly constituting government action to expand coverage.
